items.title: Alex Bigard Interview, 1960-04-30
items.q: >> [INTERVIEWEE] Is there any particular note? That's OBC. Boy, that? Turn it up. Great.

ctx.x: Well, nice. When you're not playing it, Alec, do you plug it in once in a while? No. You just leave it a little light itself. What about your snare drum? You say you have a light in your snare drum? I have a light in my snare drum. And when do you use that light? I use my foot this and all of it. I use that. Oh, I see. Just when you're playing, but when you're not playing you don't bother with it. Yeah, I do. That looks very nice. What are you turning your snare drum? You got to bring it up. Now what note?

Is there any particular note? That's OBC. Boy, that? Turn it up. Great. That's all your traps. Your big Chinese symbol is about 16 inches. Yeah. Yeah. I see this. That drum is almost. Boom. Yeah. We're going to have a hard zoom. We got a double card here for that. Yeah, we. Oh, here. Yeah, that she is. We're going to have a hard zoom. Yeah, we. Oh, here. Yeah, that she is. Wait a while. You want to take the other one now? I know the two of them combine and mix up together. Yeah, this is it. You just plug it. My…
I like to look at the snaps on that. I like them doing that.
